claims.text: The patch led to an estimated change in positive share of -3.17 percent at the 7-day horizon. Reviews came in a burst during this window; on such windows the method raised false alarms at most 10% of the time in its benchmark. The game's discounts weren't tracked at the time, so a price change can't be ruled out.

report.summary: The patch led to an estimated change in positive share of -3.17 percent at the 7-day horizon. Reviews came in a burst during this window; on such windows the method raised false alarms at most 10% of the time in its benchmark. The game's discounts weren't tracked at the time, so a price change can't be ruled out. The patch is supported. A price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive. Noise or seasonality is rejected.
